iconicAnchor.label: French Empire furniture and interiors
iconicAnchor.whyCanonical: Documented furniture and interiors establish Empire's severe symmetry, dark figured woods, gilded mounts, classical supports, and state symbolism as a precise system.

sources.title: Empire Style, 1800–1815
supports: Empire design joined strict classical form, archaeological motifs, luxurious woods, and gilt-bronze mounts to project political authority.

sources.title: American Empire pier table
supports: The documented museum object shows how polished dark wood, pale stone, mirrored axial form, and gilded mounts create controlled monumental contrast.

bundledReferenceRationale: Excellent single-image set. The lead clearly teaches symmetry, classical era, monument scale, smooth, retains its identity at card scale, and shows no visible anti-cue, integrity failure, or confusing overlap with neighboring styles. The independently approved lead is assets/refs/empire-style/generated-lead.jpg. No support image is needed because the lead carries the direction without filler.
